spec.title: Interactive Pomodoro Timer Web Application
spec.summary: A single‑page, browser‑only Pomodoro timer featuring customizable session and break durations, a visual progress bar, start/stop/reset controls, automatic transition to break mode, and an optional session history log displayed in a simple dashboard.

files.name: index.html
files.purpose: Defines the complete UI layout: timer display, start/stop/reset buttons, progress bar, break indicator, session history panel, and includes links to style.css and app.js for styling and interactivity.

files.name: style.css
files.purpose: Provides responsive, accessible styling for the timer digits, control buttons, progress bar animations, break mode highlighting, dark/light theme support, and layout of the optional session history dashboard.

files.name: app.js
files.purpose: Implements timer logic, manages session state machine (work, short break, long break), handles user interactions (start, stop, reset, custom duration inputs), updates the DOM for countdown, progress bar, mode transitions, and records session data for the optional dashboard.

files.name: data.js
files.purpose: Holds static configuration constants such as default work session length, short break length, long break length, and number of sessions before long break, ensuring easy maintenance and future extension.

acceptance_criteria: Starting the timer from the default state counts down from 25 minutes to zero in real time.
Pressing the start button while stopped initiates a countdown; pressing stop pauses the timer without resetting elapsed time.
When the timer reaches zero in work mode, the UI automatically transitions to a 5‑minute short break and after four work sessions, a 15‑minute long break begins.
The reset button returns the timer to its initial configuration, clears elapsed time, and updates the UI to show the default session length.
The progress bar accurately reflects the percentage of the current session completed, and session history entries appear after each completed session with correct timestamps.
